meaning:
ἀ-δύνατος, -ον,
[in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;]
1. of persons, unable, powerless: Act.14:8; figuratively Rom.15:1 (MM, VGT, see word).
2. Of things, impossible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:27, Luk.18:27, Rom.8:3, Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”
But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”
At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.
